collectionMethod: AI-assisted review and topic adaptation of public transport FAQ/help collections and payment/device guidance. No bulk benchmark corpus was imported. Rewritten TodaGo instructions are checked against project source code. Research papers are methodology references, not sources of transport answers.

sources.author: Angkas
sources.title: Help centre
sources.scope: Booking, discounts, wallet, route concerns, tracking, technical issues, and post-trip feedback.

sources.author: Angkas
sources.title: Customer
sources.scope: Choosing services, booking, payment, cancellation, and delivery questions.

sources.author: Angkas
sources.title: Angkas passenger
sources.scope: Booking steps, pricing explanations, and historical transaction details.

sources.author: Grab
sources.title: About Advance Bookings
sources.scope: Advance reservation creation, changes, acceptance, and availability. Source text reviewed through indexed Help Centre content; the live page can require JavaScript.

sources.author: Grab
sources.title: About Group Rides
sources.scope: Group size, stops, fare review, booking notes, tracking, and payment arrangements. Source text reviewed through indexed Help Centre content; the live page can require JavaScript.

sources.author: Grab
sources.title: Complete your selfie verification
sources.scope: Identity checks, camera access, photo quality, and retrying verification. Provider-specific processing/privacy promises are not adopted.

sources.author: Grab
sources.title: How to cancel a trip
sources.scope: Driver cancellation and passenger-requested cancellation. TodaGo eligibility is checked independently.

sources.author: Uber
sources.title: Changing your pickup location
sources.scope: Reviewing GPS suggestions, choosing addresses, and correcting pickup pins before confirmation.

sources.author: Uber
sources.title: I can't request a ride
sources.scope: Unavailable drivers, coverage, booking failure, and account/payment checks.

sources.author: Uber
sources.title: How to contact support
sources.scope: Selecting the relevant trip, reviewing its details, submitting an issue, and following up. Uber contact channels and response times do not apply to TodaGo.

sources.author: Uber
sources.title: I was charged twice or a different amount than on my receipt
sources.scope: Reviewing suspected duplicate charges. Uber authorization-hold rules are not treated as TodaGo behavior.

sources.author: Uber
sources.title: My fare doesn't match the upfront fare I was shown
sources.scope: Comparing displayed estimates, route distance, stops, and disputed fares. TodaGo's own fare formula takes precedence.

sources.author: Uber
sources.title: Forgot something in an Uber? We will help you find it!
sources.scope: Identifying the trip and contacting the appropriate person about missing belongings, without promising recovery.

sources.author: Uber
sources.title: Rating a driver
sources.scope: Post-trip stars, compliments, and issue feedback. TodaGo rating eligibility and editing limits are separately verified.

sources.author: Uber
sources.title: Getting a trip request
sources.scope: Going online/offline, accepting or declining requests, and taking a break.

sources.author: Uber
sources.title: 3 - Learn how to use the Driver App
sources.scope: Pickup/destination navigation, earnings, notifications, and driver activity. Uber payout schedules are not used.

sources.author: Uber
sources.title: I'm not getting trip or delivery requests
sources.scope: Driver availability and troubleshooting lack of incoming requests.

sources.author: Uber
sources.title: Cashing out earnings
sources.scope: Available earnings, selecting a destination account, confirmation, and payout status. TodaGo uses staff-processed GCash/Maya payouts, not Uber's schedule or instant-transfer promise.

sources.author: Uber
sources.title: I was notified I'm ineligible for Next-day Cashout
sources.scope: A previous pending payout or eligibility limits can prevent another request. TodaGo-specific checks are authoritative.

sources.author: Uber
sources.title: Contacting a rider
sources.scope: Calling or messaging the assigned participant. Uber's number masking and voice readout features are not claimed for TodaGo.

sources.author: Uber
sources.title: I can't sign up for a Rider account
sources.scope: Account registration, sign-in trouble, and account credentials. TodaGo's own registration fields and role selection are used.

sources.author: Uber
sources.title: How do I upload my profile picture?
sources.scope: Adding or updating an account photo. TodaGo's gallery/sync workflow is independently checked.

sources.author: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas
sources.title: FAQs on QR Ph person-to-merchant payments (P2M)
sources.scope: QR Ph basics, participating financial apps, device/internet requirements, merchant checks, scanning, and approval. No publication date is assumed from the PDF's internal document code.

sources.author: GCash
sources.title: Paano mag scan to pay via QR
sources.scope: Using a payment app to scan a merchant QR, review payment details, and authorize payment.

sources.author: GCash
sources.title: Did not receive money?
sources.scope: Checking transaction history, avoiding immediate retries during processing, retaining the QR reference, and contacting the merchant/provider. Published GCash reversal timelines are not promised by TodaGo.

sources.author: PayMongo
sources.title: Events
sources.scope: Provider payment outcomes and separate live/test events; supports server-confirmed rather than button-confirmed payment.

sources.author: Google
sources.title: Manage location permissions for apps
sources.scope: App-specific location access, approximate/precise access, and permission changes.

sources.author: Google
sources.title: Change app permissions on your Android phone
sources.scope: Camera, microphone, location, photo, and notification permissions. Device-specific menus can differ.

sources.author: De Bruyn, M., Lotfi, E., Buhmann, J., & Daelemans, W.
sources.title: MFAQ: A multilingual FAQ dataset
sources.publication: Proceedings of the 3rd Workshop on Machine Reading for Question Answering
sources.scope: Related literature about FAQ corpora and multilingual retrieval; no MFAQ records were imported into TodaGo.

sources.author: Karan, M., & Šnajder, J.
sources.title: Paraphrase-focused learning to rank for domain-specific frequently asked questions retrieval
sources.scope: Related literature about query wording and paraphrase-focused retrieval; TodaGo does not implement the paper's trained ranking models.

sources.author: Gebru, T., Morgenstern, J., Vecchione, B., Vaughan, J. W., Wallach, H., Daumé III, H., & Crawford, K.
sources.title: Datasheets for datasets
sources.scope: Dataset origin, collection, composition, intended use, and limitations; not a source of transport answers.

sources.author: Angkas
sources.title: Be an Angcars driver
sources.scope: Driver registration requirements and following up an application; vehicle types, dates, commercial fees, and contact details are not adopted for TodaGo.
